narrationTexts: Confirmed bug in `orderTotal`: tax is computed on the original `cents` instead of the discounted amount. Fixing and running the suite.
finalText:
**Suite is green.** 625 total, 625 passing.

Bug was in `orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41). Tax was computed on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one, so any case with both a discount and a tax was wrong. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`.

Next: nothing.
